description: §7.6 rule (b) (S479): a file-scope initializer that reaches a later binding through a chain of calls is E-SCOPE-001, as the direct read is.
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S479): "An initializer that reaches a file-scope binding declared after it — directly, or through a function it calls, at any depth — SHALL be **`E-SCOPE-001`**, the same error as reading the later binding directly". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted" item 2.
